text: Brief Introduction: How many students can have opportunities to talk with the H.E. Ambassadors in their life ? How many students can have chances to study from the H.E. Ambassadors in their life ? How many students can have the honor to work for the H.E. Ambassadors in their life? Ambassador assistant oriented foundation program will make all your dreams come true. Based on the close relation between BRCIC and embassies from more than 20 countries, our students can communicate with the H.E. Ambassadors face to face. Even some excellent students have the opportunities to be the assistant interns of the H.E. Ambassadors. Besides, topic lectures by the H.E. Ambassadors will be held in the Ambassador assistant oriented foundation program each month. Objectives and Goals: The programs will prepare students with foresight, competencies, and higher-order skills to function effectively and competitively in an evolving social and global environment. The students will be taught with modern basic theory knowledge and skills of being professional senior assistant, as well as social manners & customs. General Education Curriculum: Chinese Language , English Language, Secretarial Science and Practice, Document Writing, Information and Archive Management, Public Relation, Office Automation, Business and Social Etiquette, etc. Enrollment Scale: Small-class Teaching: 15 persons Class Timetable: 16-20 hours per week ,40 minutes per class Teaching mode: personalized training, heuristic and interactive teaching, situation mode training, role play training, case studies, topical lectures by the H.E. Ambassadors ,internship and social practice, etc.
